file_impact.reason: Exactly-one startup key source and non-secret service policy.
Validate/copy one process-owned 0700/0600 key and build the signer runtime.
Remove application runtime SSM retrieval after deployment expansion.
Compose/validate before accepting service work and clean up only the runtime copy.
Thread context-local signer/principal/push policy through jobs.
Consume context policy and preserve no-workspace-push.

Accept an explicit signer key handle + principal (ensure_opcert_key/opcert_principal/mint_opcert_record/sign_opcert_manifest) instead of reading REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH/REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID from os.environ; env resolution kept as the default for the developer-local close path.
Thread the context-local signer/principal into sign_completion_verdict; the non-service close-gate caller retains existing env/genesis default behavior via optional params.
Thread the optional context-local signer binding through the public sign_manifest (:587) AND its private delegate _sign_manifest_under_lock (:528, the mint_opcert_record caller at :567).

Thread the optional context-local signer binding through generation.sign_manifest (:261, the plan-review producer calling _sign_manifest_under_lock at :334) so opcert plan-review jobs sign from the injected key, not os.environ.
Forward the service's context-local signer binding into generation.sign_manifest (:202) on the plan-review signing path; developer-local review-plan passes no binding (env/genesis default).
Inject/mount startup material and remove application key SSM/region inputs.
Remove application boto3 runtime need and retain process runtime directory contract.
Materialize deployment-owned startup source before service start if SSM remains selected.
Startup, permissions, restart, context isolation, cleanup, signature, no-SSM, and signer-seam threading oracles.
